art_direction: 淡薄荷底，左眼将眯未闭、右眼清亮，像眨眼前的暗号。
composition_variation: Left eye a slim curved opening still containing colored edge, black pupil and a narrow ivory glint. Right eye three times taller, softly rounded below. Pair tilts only slightly upward to the right; both pupils look toward the viewer. Instant before a conspiratorial wink, neither closed eye nor squinting pain. Broad organic rounded lids, no sharp diagonal corners.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
